```{python}
#| label: fig-bench-coordcube-cost-breakdown
#| fig-cap: "Where does the 127ns CoordCube overhead go?"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

categories = ['Path generation', 'Vec allocation', 'Vec::push x9', 'Tree lookup']
values = [16, 37, 74, 158]
hatches = ['///', '\\\\', 'xxx', '']

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3))
bars = ax.barh(categories, values, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch=hatches)
ax.set_xlabel('Latency (ns)')
for i, v in enumerate(values):
    ax.text(v + 2, i, f'{v} ns', va='center', fontsize=8)
ax.axvline(x=158, color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=1, label='Baseline (158 ns)')
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```
